description: Observed and ordinary callers of one ranked group keep separate entry frames. The observed caller retains the same seal as its witness (engine §4 and §10).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution late-elision
%rule text piece | $x:piece %conditions $x.without-elision.matches(piece)

%rule piece ("x" (a ≻ b))
%rule a ("a" [+T])
%rule b ("a" [+U])
